set.body:
Scope: Independent consumer fixtures and clean checkout acceptance for the exact final provider revisions.

Deliverable: Run standalone provider consumers and the functional-analysis, MVPA, atlas/searchlight, surface readback, linked-frame, standalone volume-transform-display and atlas query/route scenarios against immutable pins without sibling overrides or local artifact leakage.

Acceptance:
- Independent neuroim4s, neuroatlas4s, mvpa4s and neurosurf4s consumers build/test without ScalaFIM or provider test internals; minimal core consumers prove optional volume/surface/display boundaries.
- ScalaFIM compile-all plus bounded JVM/JS regression batches pass; native and browser evidence is separately recorded.
- All seven scenario families in plan section 7 return explicit results; known caveats, skipped real assets and adverse evidence are retained. Record exact revisions and raw exit status; do not infer publication or new scientific qualification.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
